decisions.reason: The firm upgraded A from a mere mention to a dedicated page, reflecting increased investment and public commitment, so escalation of commitment makes dropping unlikely.
B has had its own page since launch and continues to be highlighted with a launch quote, indicating strong visible commitment and sunk costs that favor persistence.
C has remained only a mention without a dedicated page, suggesting lower public commitment, but its continued presence reflects some sunk costs; escalation is weaker so moderate drop risk.
E is recent and only mentioned, so sunk costs are limited, but early-stage results can still be attributed to temporary causes, leading to persistence.
F is a new peripheral service for wallboxes with only a mention, so less central and lower sunk costs; escalation of commitment is limited, giving a moderate chance of dropping.
